manifesto.heading: About the museum
manifesto.paragraph1: This museum gathers the voice of a land that neither wars nor oblivion could silence. The towers remember the names of clans. The blades are passed down with a name. And the memory kept by families — elders’ stories, letters, old photographs — too often leaves along with the people, unless someone writes it down in time.
manifesto.paragraph2: Four forms of memory live here. The museum halls hold three-dimensional exhibits of towers, weapons and people of the Caucasus. The Archive holds primary sources: documents, maps, manuscripts. The Family Archive holds stories sent in by readers themselves. The Journal carries articles by historians and local researchers.

submit.metaDescription: Tell your family’s story for the Family Archive: memories, legends, letters and photographs.
submit.title: Share a story
submit.description: Tell what your family remembers. There is no need to write like a historian: living details, names, places and the words of elders matter most.
tips: Elders’ memories of life, events, resettlement
Legends of your clan and teip, stories about ancestors
Old photographs — with a note on who and where
Letters, documents, certificates — just photograph them
submit.privacy: Only the editors see your contact details; they are never published. We may contact you before publishing to check details. The story appears on the site only after review.

fields.title: Title
fields.titlePlaceholder: For example: How my great-grandfather built a house in Kharachoy
fields.storyPlaceholder: Tell it in your own words: who, where, when, what happened. Names, details and the words of elders are especially valuable.
fields.photosHint: Up to {n} photos in JPG, PNG or WebP. Large images are resized automatically.
fields.caption: Caption: who, where, when
fields.storytellerPlaceholder: For example: Told by Mariam, granddaughter
fields.contactHint: Give an email or a phone number — at least one.
fields.messagePlaceholder: Optional: anything we should know, how best to reach you
fields.consentPublish: I agree to the story and photographs being published on the site after editorial review.
fields.consentRights: This is my family’s story, or I have my family’s consent, and I have the right to share these materials.
